uncertainties.meaning: The exact number of usable units collected each day is unknown because the collection rate of 12 units/hour is an average; actual hourly yield may vary. Also, whether the drive operates exactly as scheduled (e.g., no closures or delays) is uncertain.
Whether the centre actually has 150 units available for the Thursday shipment is uncertain because it depends on the cumulative collection and any intervening usage or losses (not specified).
Whether the Thursday shipment is dispatched as scheduled (4:00 PM) is uncertain; delays could occur.
Whether the shipment arrives and is received by Friday noon is uncertain; the 3-hour transit time is an estimate and could vary.
The final number of usable units at the hospital is uncertain because it depends on the above uncertainties and any consumption or wastage at the hospital (not specified).
